summary: Converts a single wide character (WideCharStr) into multi-byte form, the wide-to-ANSI mirror of the single-character conversion layer. Returns 0 when the output buffer lpMultiByteStr is NULL. When no locale is set (dword_8D3F38 == 0) and the character fits in one byte (WideCharStr <= 0xFF), it writes the truncation directly into the buffer and returns 1. Otherwise it calls WideCharToMultiByte(CodePage, 0x220u, &WideCharStr, 1, output, cbMultiByte, 0, &defaultCharUsed) and returns the byte count written, or -1 with TLS error 42 when conversion fails or a default (replacement) character was used.

local_names.result: byte count written / success indicator; NULL-default-char flag is observed via lpMultiByteStr

operations.description: Seed result with the output buffer pointer: result = lpMultiByteStr.
Return result (0) immediately when lpMultiByteStr is NULL.
When dword_8D3F38 (locale) is zero and WideCharStr <= 0xFF, take the direct truncation path.
Write the wide character truncated to one byte into the output buffer at this+0x0 (*lpMultiByteStr = WideCharStr) and return 1.
Call WideCharToMultiByte(CodePage, 0x220u, &WideCharStr, 1, output buffer, cbMultiByte, 0, &defaultCharUsed) and store the byte count written as result.
Failure path taken when the conversion returned 0 or a default (replacement) character flag was set.
On failure store error 42 via TLSOffsetGetter() and return -1.
Return result (byte count written) on success, or -1 on failure.
Called by sub_596030 (00596030) as the single-character wide-to-ANSI conversion step.
